defaultRules: Unknown baselines remain unknown until measured.
Local counters stay on-device unless the user explicitly exports an aggregate diagnostic snapshot.
Public reporting uses minimum cohort thresholds and suppresses small cells.
No metric may be used to profile, price-discriminate, or degrade the free direct route.

metrics.name: Qualified multiplayer documentation visit rate
metrics.question: Are interested visitors reaching multiplayer setup and evidence pages?
metrics.numerator: Qualified visits to multiplayer documentation or release evidence pages
metrics.denominator: All visits to the linked GameDeck public entry pages
metrics.decisionUse: Improve navigation and recruitment copy without claiming product availability.
metrics.caveats: Platform analytics are directional and may deduplicate differently.

metrics.name: Tester call response rate
metrics.question: Does a bounded tester request produce useful responses?
metrics.numerator: Responses that include the requested OS, controller, and network categories
metrics.denominator: Views or impressions of the exact tester call where the platform exposes them
metrics.decisionUse: Choose channels and wording for future reviewed recruitment.
metrics.caveats: Missing impression data keeps the denominator unknown.

metrics.name: Host preflight completion rate
metrics.question: Can a host finish the local readiness flow?
metrics.numerator: Host preflights reaching a terminal ready or blocked result
metrics.decisionUse: Prioritize readiness failures and flow friction.
metrics.caveats: No cross-device total exists unless users opt in to aggregate export.

metrics.name: Invitation creation success rate
metrics.question: Can an eligible host create a bounded invitation?
metrics.denominator: Invitation creation attempts reaching a terminal result
metrics.caveats: Never retain or export invite contents, codes, or tokens.

metrics.name: Guest invitation parse success rate
metrics.question: Can a guest safely parse a received invitation?
metrics.numerator: Invitation parses returning a valid bounded contract
metrics.denominator: Invitation parse attempts reaching a terminal result
metrics.caveats: Never retain or export the invitation payload.

metrics.name: Readiness pass rate
metrics.question: How often does a requested route pass deterministic readiness checks?
metrics.denominator: Readiness checks reaching any terminal result
metrics.caveats: Export only aggregate counts after explicit review and consent.

metrics.name: Readiness terminal reason share
metrics.question: Which stable public reason most often ends readiness?
metrics.numerator: Readiness terminal results for one fixed public reason code
metrics.denominator: All readiness checks reaching a terminal result
metrics.decisionUse: Rank repair guidance without collecting private paths or payloads.
metrics.caveats: Reason codes must be allowlisted and path-free.

metrics.name: Direct connection success rate
metrics.question: How often does an eligible direct route connect?
metrics.denominator: Direct connection attempts reaching connected or terminal failure
metrics.decisionUse: Decide where NAT diagnostics need improvement.
metrics.caveats: No IP addresses, candidates, or network identifiers are retained.

metrics.name: Relay fallback success rate
metrics.question: When relay is explicitly selected, does it connect?
metrics.denominator: Relay attempts reaching connected or terminal failure
metrics.decisionUse: Evaluate relay reliability and stop-loss thresholds.
metrics.caveats: Only relay service aggregate counts and cost totals are permitted.

metrics.name: Invite-to-playable p95
metrics.question: How long does a supported session take from invitation open to playable?
metrics.numerator: Duration values for qualifying sessions that reach playable
metrics.calculation: p95(numerator duration series); denominator is the sample count
metrics.caveats: Suppress publication below the minimum cohort size.

metrics.name: Playable session rate
metrics.question: How often does a started multiplayer attempt reach playable?
metrics.denominator: Session attempts reaching playable or a terminal failure
metrics.decisionUse: Measure end-to-end reliability by truthful route.
metrics.caveats: Does not record game titles or library contents.

metrics.name: Reconnect success rate
metrics.question: After a recoverable disconnect, does the session resume?
metrics.denominator: Reconnect attempts reaching resumed play or terminal recovery
metrics.decisionUse: Prioritize reconnect correctness and recovery copy.
metrics.caveats: No peer address or session token is retained.

metrics.name: Clean teardown rate
metrics.question: Do sessions release capture, input, and processes cleanly?
metrics.numerator: Session endings confirmed clean by the local lifecycle manager
metrics.denominator: All session endings reaching a terminal teardown result
metrics.decisionUse: Detect lifecycle leaks and stuck-input risk.
metrics.caveats: Local counter only; detailed logs remain user-controlled.

metrics.name: Repeat-play intent rate
metrics.question: Do participants say they intend to play again?
metrics.numerator: Survey responses selecting likely or very likely
metrics.denominator: All completed responses to the exact optional question
metrics.decisionUse: Guide onboarding and playtest format without cross-session tracking.
metrics.caveats: Self-reported intent is not behavioral retention.

metrics.name: Reproducible compatibility report rate
metrics.question: Are community reports complete enough to reproduce?
metrics.numerator: Submitted reports meeting the published evidence checklist
metrics.denominator: All submitted compatibility reports reviewed in the period
metrics.decisionUse: Improve report forms and compatibility coverage.
metrics.caveats: Exact game evidence is user-submitted, never inferred from a library.

metrics.name: Relay cost per successful session
metrics.question: What does optional relay capacity cost for successful sessions?
metrics.numerator: Relay bandwidth, compute, and egress cost in the reporting period
metrics.denominator: Successful relay sessions in the same reporting period
metrics.decisionUse: Set transparent cost envelopes and stop-loss thresholds before pricing.
metrics.caveats: No pricing commitment follows from this metric alone.
